verdict.rationale: Capacities' AI privacy docs say AI features are fully opt-in, and that no space data is shared with third-party AI services unless AI is activated. Declining AI therefore effectively keeps your data away from model providers. The evidence never addresses training directly, so users who want the AI features have no documented guarantee that their data stays out of training. Missing for 10: explicit no-training commitment for data sent to AI providers, a training opt-out that works while AI features stay enabled, and independent corroboration of the privacy claim.
